name: Leo SEVIN
intro: I am a PE teacher with **8 years of experience**, including **PE coordination** and **Cambridge IGCSE PE**. I currently teach at Crescendo-HELP International School in Malaysia.
bridge: I work to improve and modernise PE with **online tools** that students and teachers use every day.
valueBridge: It is the same aim I bring to my PE teaching, with **online tools** that students and teachers use every day.
noFactLine: I believe students grow when they take responsibility for their own progress, and my **self-assessment app** puts them in charge of it.

bullets.text: **Holistic assessment.** With **4 years as PE coordinator**, I use a **5 core skills holistic assessment with levels 1 to 4** that sets clear expectations for every sport and year group. In my self-assessment app, students rate themselves at the first and last lesson of a unit, and I assess them at the first, middle and last.

**Online tools.** I build **online tools** for students and teachers: a gym app where students calculate their repetition maximum and start a training plan linked to their sport, plus bleep test and athletics trackers with house points.
**IGCSE Specialist.** I created an online workbook from the 11 chapters of the Collins Cambridge IGCSE PE book, with 187 checked questions, auto-marked quizzes and a leaderboard.

**Programmes and events.** At Saigon Star I led PE programming and assessment across the UK, IPC and IMYC curricula and introduced a House Team system. I organise events in the JSAC and FOBISIA circuits.

availability: My contract ends in July 2027, so I can start in **August 2027**.
websiteLine: You can see my teaching style, videos and apps on {website}
closing: I have attached my CV. Thank you for your time. I would welcome a short call to discuss how I could contribute to your PE department.
